name: Uwase Diane
comment: I bought a full bedding set for my new house and the quality is excellent. The family running the shop is so welcoming — I'll be back for curtains next.

name: Niyonzima Eric
comment: Best tracksuits in Byumba Market, hands down. Fair prices and they let me try before I paid. Highly recommend.

name: Mukamana Solange
comment: Good selection of suitcases for my trip. Delivery to Kigali took a little longer than expected but the quality made up for it.

name: Habimana Jean de Dieu
comment: The curtains I ordered were exactly as pictured and fitted perfectly. Great communication over WhatsApp throughout.
